lines.zh: 扇动巨大翅膀飞越山谷。
lines.en: Beat enormous wings over the valley.

lines.zh: 振翅掠过岩壁上的裂缝。
lines.en: Wings sweep over the cracks on the cliff.
Swoop down from the sky over the ground.
Adjust flight with the tail fin.
Wings slice through the sky like wind.
Circle in the air, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 俯冲攻击低空飞行的生物。
lines.en: Swoop down to attack flying prey.
Sweep over the lake, splashing water.
Swoop down to hunt from above.
Beat wings to take off from the ground.
Its wings spread and blot out half the sky.

lines.zh: 它借上升气流爬得更高
lines.en: It rides an updraft higher.
Neck outstretched, it glides over the ridge.

lines.zh: 后肢收起，只用翼尖转向
lines.en: Legs tucked, it steers with its wingtips.

lines.zh: 它助跑几步才离开地面
lines.en: It takes a few running steps before lifting off.
The wing membrane pulls taut in the wind.
Rest quietly on the cliff.
Hover on the rock without flying.
Lie on a huge rock basking in the sun.

lines.zh: 缓缓转动头部环顾四周。
lines.en: Turn head slowly to survey the area.
Slothfully beat the wings.
Look to the sky, emitting a low moan.
Roam leisurely in the sky.
Rest quietly, waiting for prey.
Circle slowly in the air.
Rest leisurely by beating wings.
It tucks its long beak under a wing.
It spreads its wings to bask in the sun.
It stands on one leg at the cliff’s point.
It grooms its wing membrane slowly.
Fix gaze on prey, eyes sharp.

lines.zh: 我压低翅膀，影子罩住你的路。
lines.en: I lower my wings; my shadow covers your path.
Moo and lock on player.
Scan with gaze at player.
From up here, you look tiny.

lines.zh: 我收起翼膜，落在你面前。
lines.en: I fold my wing membrane and land before you.
Eyes glint, locking on target.
Eyes alert, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 我斜过翼尖，把你看在眼里。
lines.en: I tilt my wingtip and keep you in sight.

lines.zh: 我的翼展遮住了你头顶的天。
lines.en: My wingspan blots out the sky above you.
It eyes you sidelong from high above.
It cocks its head and watches with one eye.

lines.zh: 一边翅膀漏风，我只能走。
lines.en: One wing leaks air; I can only walk.
Tail bitten, it hurts.
My wing tilted. I'm going down.

lines.zh: 翼膜吸满水，我沉进湖里。
lines.en: My wing membrane soaks through; I sink into the lake.
Lightning hit, so painful.
Starving to death.

lines.zh: 风停了，我摔在崖边的碎石上。
lines.en: The wind dies; I crash onto the cliff scree.
Surrounded by fire, run!
Torn away by tornado!
Attacked by predator, injured.
You're getting too close, human.
Enjoy your meal.

lines.zh: 我的飞行技术无人能及。
lines.en: My flight is unmatched.
No prey around here.
Get away, little bug.

lines.zh: 你那点肉不够塞牙缝的。
lines.en: Your meat won't even fill a tooth.
Move, I'm resting.

lines.zh: 这块肉是我的，退到崖下去。
lines.en: This carcass is mine; get off my cliff.
Human food isn't for me.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片可以防任何攻击。
lines.en: My scales deflect any attack.

lines.zh: 你的头撞到我的翅膀上了。
lines.en: Your head hit my wing.
I hit you.

lines.zh: 翅膀一张，这块天亮了一半。
lines.en: One spread of my wings shades half the sky.
Move, I'm flying.
Your collision won't harm me.
You hit my wing bone; that stings.
You tried to stop me flying.
I slapped you with my wing.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀挡住了你的攻击。
lines.en: My wing blocked your attack.
You hit my body.

lines.zh: 这片天空，只够我们两个。
lines.en: This sky is only big enough for two.
My mate, fly with me.
We search for a new home.
Answer my call.
We rule the skies together.
My wings protect you.
We search for food together.
My call attracts you.
Let's establish a new territory.
Touch me with your触须

lines.zh: 巨大的翅膀拍打着空气。
lines.en: Large wings flap the air.
I hear its whisper.
Its feathers reflect sunlight.
Its eyes stare at you.
I feel its power.
I fly to it.
Its scales are hard as stone.
Its tail swings.
I enjoy this flight.
It leads me to treasure.

lines.zh: 你踏进我的崖顶，风也停了。
lines.en: You step onto my cliff; even the wind stops.
I see you.
I will attack you.
Wings spread — clear the runway.

lines.zh: 它收翅的那一下，就是要落爪。
lines.en: The moment it folds its wings, the claws fall.

lines.zh: 从高空看，你的影子太小。
lines.en: From up here your shadow looks tiny.

lines.zh: 你的影子在草地上，太小了。
lines.en: Your shadow on the grass is far too small.
I won't let you go.
I am ready to fight.

lines.zh: 从天上俯视，你的位置很清楚。
lines.en: From up here, your spot is plain.
You have entered its airspace.
It lets go of the cliff top.
It has marked you inside its territory.
Its wing shadow sweeps over your feet.

lines.zh: 长喙已经对准你的后颈。
lines.en: My long beak is aimed at your nape.
You will be tamed.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶绕圈，等风转向。
lines.en: I circle overhead, waiting for the wind to turn.
You are mine.
Tame it.
It's yours.
Capture it.
Tame this creature.
I will tame it.
Make it my servant.
It draws circles above your head.
It folds its wings, ready to dive.
It drops low, skimming the treetops.
It lines its long beak up with you.
It spirals tighter and tighter around you.
Roar shakes the valley!
Wings slice through the air!
Sharp beak pierces the sky!

lines.zh: 后爪扣住你的肩，往天上带。
lines.en: My hind claws hook your shoulder and lift.
Giant wings扫sunset!
Flames scorch foes!
Dive for prey!

lines.zh: 四根爪子一起收拢，像钩子。
lines.en: Four claws close together like hooks.
Roar shakes the forest!
Roar drives away clouds!
Its long beak stabs down like a spear.
A wing bone sweeps you off your feet.
Its hind claws clamp onto your shoulder.
The wind of its dive forces your head down.
Hatches at nightfall!
Breaks out of shell in caves!
Appears in dawn!
Born in deep caverns!
Hatches in rock crevices!
Grows in caves!

lines.zh: 我从蛋壳里挣出，火山在背后。
lines.en: I break free of the shell, volcano behind me.
In rock crevice!
Deep in rock!
Awakens in caves!
A long cry comes from the cliff top.
It drops out from under the clouds.
Its shadow arrives before the wings.
It lands on the ridge and folds its wings.
A hatchling breaks shell and spreads its wings.

lines.zh: 气流把它托上高高的崖
lines.en: An updraft carries it up to the cliff.

lines.zh: 骨与肉的气味引来了它
lines.en: The smell of bone and meat draws it in.

lines.zh: 它从远处的火山口飞来
lines.en: It flies in from the distant caldera.
The sky falls briefly silent.

lines.zh: 它的长鸣盖过整片山谷
lines.en: Its cry fills the whole valley.

lines.zh: 火舌卷上翼膜，我往高处逃。
lines.en: Flames curl up my wing membrane; I climb.

lines.zh: 翅膀受了伤，飞不起来了，摔落的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Wounded wings, can't fly now — and the fall makes it worse.

lines.zh: 尾巴被咬了，好疼，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Tail bitten, it hurts — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 被箭射中了，好疼，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Arrow hit, it hurts — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我被淹死了，中箭的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Drowned to death — and the projectile makes it worse.

lines.zh: 被雷劈中了，真疼，中魔法的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Lightning hit, so painful — and the magic makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我饿坏了，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Starving to death — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下来了，遭雷击的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Fallen from high up — and the lightning makes it worse.

lines.zh: 被火包围了，快逃，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Surrounded by fire, run! — and the void makes it worse.
